entities.summary: Chie Tsuji is a former volleyball player from Japan. Her maiden name was Chie Natori . Tsuji competed with the Japan women's national volleyball team at the 2004 Summer Olympics in Athens, where she finished in fifth place. She won a bronze medal at the 1994 Goodwill Games in Saint Petersburg. Tsuji played as a setter. Chie Tsuji was a athletes & competitors from Kofu (b. 1969-08-09, Kofu).
